gbm_population_evidence.quote: Central Nervous System Neoplasms; Glioblastoma; Gliosarcoma, Adult; Anaplastic Oligodendroglioma; Anaplastic Astrocytoma
Primary CNS neoplasms in this study include, but are not limited to, the following: glioblastoma and glioblastoma histologic subtypes, gliosarcoma, primary CNS sarcomas

candidate_evidence.quote: ONC206 is a member of the imipridone class of anti-cancer small molecules that share a unique tri-heterocyclic core chemical structure and target G protein-coupled receptors.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients aged ≥18 years with a recurrent, primary CNS neoplasm.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: After Protocol Amendment 6, all available PK data will also be considered for dose escalation decisions.

role_evidence.quote: single-agent, oral ONC206 in patients with recurrent, primary central nervous system (CNS) neoplasms

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational imipridone small molecule (ONC206), GPCR-targeting, related to ONC201
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: imipridone class anti-cancer small molecule targeting G protein-coupled receptors

coder_notes: Mixed primary CNS neoplasm trial; glioblastoma named in conditions and inclusion. PK is planned (PK data used for dose escalation) but sample type not stated, so tumour_pk_planned = unclear. Archival tumour specimen required for unspecified 'biomarker assays' (no linked endpoint) -> target engagement coded no. H3 K27M-mutant diffuse gliomas are conditionally excluded (not an entry requirement), so not recorded as a biomarker.
